login._screen: The sign-in screen (/login): a card asking for the email to send a sign-in code to, and a link to sign in with Google. There is no password anywhere in the product.
login.continue: Button that sends the code. Short.
login.google: Link that goes to Google sign-in.

code._screen: The screen after asking for a code: the person types the 6-digit code we emailed. They can ask for another code or go back to change the email.
code.sent_to: Keep … around the email; {{email}} is the address the person typed.
code.submit: Button that checks the code and signs in.

home._screen: What a signed-in person sees before belonging to any company: an empty state with one action, signing out.
home.title: Empty-state title: says what is not there yet.

errors._screen: Error messages of signing in and of the session, shown under the field or on the sign-in screen. One per error code the API returns. Short, say what happened and what to do next; never blame the person.
errors.too_many_code_requests: Rate limit on asking for codes; do not give the limit or the wait time.
errors.too_many_attempts: Rate limit on typing codes; do not give the limit or the wait time.
errors.contact_support: Shown when the account cannot be opened with this identity (an email already used by another account). Do not mention the other account.
